output.summary: Adds a POST /orders feature across layers: route registration, handler, service with quantity validation, and an in-memory storage layer. A test covers the service. No requirement was given, so only the apparent intent is described.

groups.title: POST /orders route registered
groups.description: registerRoutes wires a new postOrder handler, which forwards the body to the service. Check that the unvalidated body cast is acceptable.

groups.title: createOrder service validates and stores
groups.description: createOrder rejects quantities below 1 and delegates to insertOrder. Confirm the validation rules are sufficient, for example for non-integer quantities.

groups.title: In-memory order storage
groups.description: New OrderRow type and insertOrder, which assigns incrementing ids in a module-level array. Check that non-persistent storage is intended.

groups.title: createOrder test
groups.description: A single test checks that the first created order gets id 1. Check whether the rejection path is covered.
